description.value:
Cost two Ward-Scrawled Charms

Burn two Ward-Scrawled Charms together as one action for a single, stronger combined effect.

Burn two Charms at once. Both effects occur, and each is heightened as though prepared at one rank higher than you can normally prepare. If the two Charms would produce the same effect, it does not occur twice — instead its duration is doubled, or its area increased by half, whichever the effect has.

cinderfall.incomplete: The entire effect is defined in terms of 'the Charm's stored effect,' which is itself undefined at the rule-element level -- Ward-Scrawled Charm's own card stores one of two abilities chosen at craft time with no fixed numeric effect. With no base effect to heighten or double, there is nothing concrete here to build against.
